g.text: Where aisleflow beats plain lifelong PIBT, and where it does not

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Both panels compare against the same reference: plain lifelong PIBT, which is aisleflow with every mechanism switched off.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Blue is ahead of it, red is behind it, and the number is the percentage difference in throughput over the same seeds.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Aisleflow is ahead by 22-39% on the 2 aisle-constrained maps and behind by 13-15% on the 2 open ones. Adding mechanisms is not monotonic:

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: on an open floor the machinery that clears a corridor is overhead, so pick the configuration for the floor. Bold is p < 0.05.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781

g.text: 5 seeds x 400 timesteps, Poisson arrivals, generated 2026-09-01T07:17:52Z from aisleflow @ b00ff91 by experiments/run_all.py
